resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register's Built field gives 1954, but its description says the tower was constructed in 1953. The record keeps the structured 1954 value and the story reports both dates.
Jackson's Ramblings gives AL 45 with the same US 866 number; the Register gives AL 44. The record uses the Register's AL 44 as the primary source.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. NHLR is the main source. The Weebly Allison page has a header only (Choctaw County, Alabama Forestry Commission) and no body text. Jackson's Ramblings repeats the Register's description and gives AL 45 where the Register gives AL 44. The UWA archive listing includes an August 9, 1926 letter from Mr. Allison to Major Bunker about a lookout tower; no tower is named, so it is not linked to Rudder Hill. Brief record matched on the 1954 built field and 2010 registration. The 1953 date comes from the Register description and is added as a replacement event. No photos added. Not verified: current condition, access, staffing and fires. The drone video and any other video or social posts were not read and are not cited.
